Lindsey Graham, who never met a Middle East country he didn't want to invade,
"passed away from a brief and sudden illness" on Saturday night, according to
a short statement from his office.
[Media](https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/politics-news/sen-lindsey-graham-
dies-71-brief-sudden-illness-rcna552722)
[outlets](https://www.washingtonpost.com/politics/2026/07/12/lindsey-graham-
longtime-south-carolina-senator-dies-71/) are reporting that emergency medical
services offered CPR to a man suffering from "cardiac arrest" at a Capitol
Hill home owned by the Republican senator shortly before 9pm ET last night.

The 71-year-old Graham, who was first elected to the Senate in 2002, had been
scheduled to appear on NBC News's 'Meet the Press' this morning, after
returning from a trip to Ukraine. His sudden death, notes the _[New York
Times](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/07/12/us/politics/lindsey-graham-death-
reelection-seat.html?eafs_enabled=false)_ , "comes less than four months
before he was set to appear on the ballot as a strong favorite to win a fifth
term."

Tributes have been pouring in for Graham, including from [Donald
Trump](https://thehill.com/homenews/administration/5964461-trump-tribute-
senator-graham/) and [genocidal](https://www.timesofisrael.com/iran-cites-ben-
gvirs-call-to-burn-all-of-lebanon-as-proof-of-israels-genocidal-intent/)
Israeli minister Itamar Ben-Gvir, who
[said](https://x.com/itamarbengvir/status/2076191208691396932): "Today, Israel
has lost one of its greatest friends."

A proud neoconservative hawk from South Carolina and a shamelessly sycophantic
ally of the president, Graham was perhaps one of the most controversial,
outspoken, and well-known Republicans in the country.

So here he is, Lindsey Graham, in his own very provocative, often offensive,
and typically inconsistent words, on everything from "leveling" Gaza to
threatening Cuba to fawning over Donald J. Trump to slamming Ted Cruz:

### **On Trump Then**

"He's a race-baiting, xenophobic, religious bigot." ([December 8,
2015](https://www.cnn.com/videos/politics/2015/12/08/lindsey-graham-donald-
trump-xenophobic-bigot-interview-newday.cnn))

"If we nominate Trump, we will get destroyed… and we will deserve it." ([May
3, 2016](https://x.com/LindseyGrahamSC/status/727604522156228608))

"Trump and I, we've had a hell of a journey. I hate it being this way. Oh my
God, I hate it. But today, all I can say is count me out. Enough is enough."
([January 6, 2021](https://www.wbtv.com/2021/01/06/lindsey-graham-count-me-
out-enough-is-enough/))

### **On Trump Now**

"The greatest president of all time." ([January 6,
2026](https://www.yahoo.com/news/videos/lindsey-graham-trump-greatest-
president-023502267.html))

"They should change the Nobel Prize to the Trump Prize."​ ([May 27,
2026](https://www.yahoo.com/news/politics/articles/lindsey-graham-branded-
pathetic-saying-150220190.html))

"Mr. President, you're not far behind God." ([June 9, 2026](https://www.the-
independent.com/news/world/americas/us-politics/lindsey-graham-trump-god-
election-b2993513.html))

### **On Trump 's Impeachment Trial**

"I'm not trying to pretend to be a fair juror here." ([December 14,
2019](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2019/dec/14/trump-impeachment-
lindsey-graham-will-not-pretend-to-be-a-fair-juror))

### **On 2020 Election Denial**

"If Republicans don't challenge and change the U.S. election system, there
will never be another Republican president elected again. President Trump
should not concede." ([November 8,
2020](https://thehill.com/homenews/525063-lindsey-graham-if-trump-concedes-
election-republicans-will-never-elect-another/))

### **On Trump 's 'Go Back' Tweets to Four Non-White Congresswomen**

"I don't think it's racist to say. I don't think a Somali refugee embracing
Trump would be asked to go back." ([July 18,
2019](https://www.nytimes.com/2019/07/18/us/politics/ilhan-omar-donald-
trump.html))

### **On Assassinating Putin**

"The only way this ends is for somebody in Russia to take this guy out."
([March 3, 2022](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=MVb54YzbBOk))
